A nested table wrapped in a div still renders as its own table rather than raw pipes

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<table><tr><th>Summary</th></tr><tr><td>Before<div><table><tr><th>Item</th><th>Amount</th></tr><tr><td>Alpha</td><td>10</td></tr></table></div></td></tr></table>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
